name: reference-dhis2-mosip-integration
description: This is a reference implementation of a **DHIS2 MOSIP Integration** from within the DHIS2 Capture App, with a FHIR-compliant electronic health record backend protected by OAuth2 authorization.  This is an example which should be used for reference, it **SHOULD NOT** be used directly in production.

scripts.build-plugin: cd esignet-capture-plugin && yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn build --no-verify
scripts.start-services: docker compose -f esignet-docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.yml -f tests/docker-compose.test.yml up --build --renew-anon-volumes --force-recreate --remove-orphans
